hits.title: Quadratic unitary Cayley graphs over finite commutative rings
hits.abstract_snippet: Let $R$ be a finite commutative ring with identity, and let $T_R=Q_R\cup(-Q_R)$, where $Q_R=\{u^2:u\in R^\times\}$. In this paper, we investigate the spectral properties of quadratic unitary Cayley graphs $\operatorname{Cay}(R,T_R)$, over finite commutative rings with identity. hits.title: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
hits.abstract_snippet: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. hits.title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
hits.abstract_snippet: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. hits.title: Cayley Regression for Finite Groups with a Cyclic Subgroup of Index Two
